meta.name: review-findings
meta.description: Addresses and fixes findings from a QA code review. Reads the review report, fixes critical and warning issues, and prepares for re-verification. Delegates to the Forja (Dev) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动修复代码审查发现的问题并准备重新验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果收到代码审查报告后想自动修复问题并准备重新验证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically fix code review findings and prepare for re-verification
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically fix issues from a code review and prepare for re-verification

howto.what: 读取 QA 代码审查报告，修复所有严重和警告问题，更新测试，扫描死代码，并生成修复报告供 QA 重新验证。
howto.when: 收到 Centinela (QA) 的代码审查报告后，或当需要修复审查发现的问题时触发。

say.text: 运行 /review-findings 修复最近的审查发现。
say.note: Claude 会自动找到最近的审查报告并处理。

howto.what_en: Reads the QA code review report, fixes all critical and warning issues, updates tests, scans for dead code, and prepares a fix report for QA re-verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered after receiving a code review from Centinela (QA) or when a review report has findings that need to be addressed.

say_en.note: Claude will read the report and start fixing.

say_en.text: Run /review-findings to fix the latest review findings.
say_en.note: Claude will automatically find the most recent review.
